title: Conditional GraphGANFed: Optimizing Graph-Structured Molecule Generation in Federated Generative Adversarial Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.24610v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative adversarial networks (GANs) have garnered considerable attention in molecular discovery for their ability to generate novel and high-quality molecules. To efficiently train a GAN model while preserving data privacy, GraphGANFed has been proposed to incorporate federated learning and graph convolutional networks into GAN. Yet, GraphGANFed cannot produce synthetic molecules that only optimize a user-defined metric(s) to facilitate the new drug discovery process. To address this issue, we introduce a novel extension to GraphGANFed, namely conditional GraphGANFed (cGraphGANFed), by incorporating the critic network to assess generated molecules using user-defined metric(s). The evaluation results from both the critic network and discriminator are integrated into the loss function of the generator, guiding it to generate novel molecules that maintain similar chemical properties to real ones while optimizing user-defined metrics. translated_title: 条件化GraphGANFed：在联邦生成对抗网络中优化图结构分子生成
translated_abstract: 生成对抗网络（GANs）因其生成新颖且高质量分子的能力，在分子发现领域引起了广泛关注。为了在保护数据隐私的同时高效训练GAN模型，GraphGANFed被提出，它将联邦学习和图卷积网络整合到GAN中。然而，GraphGANFed无法生成仅优化用户定义指标（以促进新药发现过程）的合成分子。为解决此问题，我们引入了GraphGANFed的新扩展，即条件化GraphGANFed（cGraphGANFed），通过加入批评家网络来评估使用用户定义指标生成的分子。批评家网络和判别器的评估结果被整合到生成器的损失函数中，引导其生成既保持与真实分子相似化学性质又优化用户定义指标的新颖分子。
tldr: 本文提出条件化GraphGANFed，通过集成批评家网络和用户定义指标，使联邦GAN在生成分子时能同时保持化学性质相似并优化特定目标，从而增强新药发现过程。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Conditional GraphGANFed, which integrates a critic network and user-defined metrics to enable federated GANs to generate molecules that maintain chemical similarity while optimizing specific objectives, thereby enhancing drug discovery.
